errors.text: The proposed refractory-element addition does not reconstruct the target intervention of high-energy ball milling followed by spark plasma sintering.
The cited evidence concerns SLM-processed equiatomic CoCrFeMnNi, not W- or Mo-modified CoCrFeNiTi, so it does not support the proposed intervention.
No refractory-element concentration, alloy-production route, milling or sintering parameters, or quantitative processing window is specified.
The predicted outcome is qualitative and non-falsifiable, with no hardness, strength, density, phase-fraction, or grain-size target relative to unmodified CoCrFeNiTi.
The stated FCC single-phase mediator conflicts with the target mixed FCC/BCC nanocrystalline structure and is not justified for refractory-modified CoCrFeNiTi.
The baseline is incorrectly changed from cast or unmodified CoCrFeNiTi to CoCrFeMnNi alloys.
